scope: Controllable model iteration independently of optional research/review addons

local_checks.command: PYTHONPATH=src python -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_controls.py -v

behavior_covered: Default one-candidate budget and same-state low-level entrypoint checks
Active slots released on cancellation without refunding total reservations
Required changed-factor declaration and tamper detection
Atomic concurrent reservations cannot overspend the last slot
Project pause blocks dispatch and promotion while existing jobs drain
Resume does not renew budget or approve a specification
Stop-on-acceptance blocks new candidates and prepared-job dispatch
Revised specifications retain prior active work and operator pause
Failed materialization preserves patch/failure and spent reservation
Legacy specifications need new review for new candidate creation
Whole-experiment timeout across individually short commands
Cancellation during acceptance cannot publish a successful verdict
Separate CLI processes observe durable limits and stop reasons
Core-only skill installation has no research addon dependency
limitations: Approvals and model tasks are simulated Python behavioral fixtures
No new real user model project was approved or trained
No actual literature-search or multi-agent LLM workflow was validated
Controls apply to registered projects in one state root, not unrestricted host callers
Time monitoring is cooperative/polled and cleanup may take additional time
No aggregate memory, GPU, currency or token quota is implemented
Development acceptance is not independent statistical confirmation
